title: P4 spiral-wave reference trajectory
layout: [frame][channel][y][x]; u plane then v plane for each frame
sourceProcessing: Bilinear source cell resampling to128; C4 projection; 5-point PDE warmup 2,000 Euler steps. L rescaled to match leading diffusion of source9-point stencil. Spatial C4 average every100steps during warmup and every25steps during capture to suppress roundoff. No temporal closure projection, no interpolation between phases.
symmetryRotation: (x,y)->(-y mod N,x); lattice point at index(0,0), equivalent to(N/2,N/2)
status: finite genuine forward PDE trajectory, not a verified periodic orbit
